# Zyglo Tech Enterprise

> Zyglo Tech Enterprise is an AI and IT solutions company headquartered in Salem, Tamil Nadu, India. It builds AI chatbots, WhatsApp automation agents, GST-ready ERP systems, workflow automation, and mobile/web applications for small and medium enterprises across India.

Zyglo Tech Enterprise Pvt. Ltd. was founded in 2021 in Salem, Tamil Nadu. It has delivered products to 50+ Indian businesses and trained 100+ students through Zyglo Academy. The company operates two service divisions: an IT Services division (websites, apps, ERP, local SEO, college/institution projects) and an AI Services division (chatbots, sales agents, workflow automation, AI assistants, SEO/AEO/GEO ranking, digital transformation).

Headquarters: 18/10, Rail Nagar, Suramangalam, Salem, Tamil Nadu 636005, India
Phone: +91 9943 907 643
Email: zyglotech@gmail.com
Website: https://www.zyglotech.com

## Services

- [AI Chatbot & Appointment Agents](https://www.zyglotech.com/services/ai-chatbots): WhatsApp and website AI chatbots for customer support, lead capture, and appointment booking.
- [AI Sales & Lead Qualification Agents](https://www.zyglotech.com/services/ai-agents): AI agents that engage, score, and follow up with leads automatically.
- [Workflow Automation](https://www.zyglotech.com/services/workflow-automation): Automating invoicing, approvals, HR, and inventory processes.
- [Personal & Business AI Assistants](https://www.zyglotech.com/services/ai-assistants): Custom AI assistants trained on a business's own data.
- [SEO, AEO & GEO Ranking Services](https://www.zyglotech.com/services/seo-aeo-geo): Search, answer-engine, and generative-engine optimization for ranking on Google, ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity.
- [Digital Transformation](https://www.zyglotech.com/services/digital-transformation): Digital readiness audits and phased technology modernization roadmaps.
- [GST-Ready ERP Setup & Customization](https://www.zyglotech.com/services/erp-solutions): ERP systems covering finance, inventory, HR, CRM, and GST-compliant billing.
- [Website Development](https://www.zyglotech.com/services/web-development): Business websites and web applications built with Next.js and React.
- [App Development](https://www.zyglotech.com/services/app-development): Native and cross-platform Android/iOS app development.
- [Google Business Setup & Local SEO](https://www.zyglotech.com/services/google-business): Google Business Profile optimization and local search ranking.
- [College & Final Year Projects](https://www.zyglotech.com/services/college-projects): Final-year engineering, IoT, and AI/ML projects for students.
